newsitem.title: USA: Humana Inc Q3 shr falls to $0.20.
newsitem.headline: Humana Inc Q3 shr falls to $0.20.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: First Call consensus estimate for the 1996 third quarter was $0.22 per share.
1996 third quarter includes $0.02 per share for severance payments made with the company's management reorganization.

1996 nine months net and per share includes special charges before income taxes of $200 million ($130 million net of income tax benefit or $0.80 per share) related primarily to the restructuring of the company's Washington, D.C., health plan, expected losses provision on insurance contracts, closing 13 service areas and discontinuing unprofitable products in three markets.
Net income before special charges was $120 million. Earnings before special charges was $0.74.
